text:
maria_cs: Quick heads-up on Nimbus onboarding — we're seeing a ~2.2x unit cost uptick and occasional tail latency spikes on long sessions (>1k tokens). Thinking of a proactive performance nudge: try an int8 quant model for >80% traffic, keep fp16 for quality-sensitive routes, plus a routing canary. Thoughts?
rajesh_eng: Agree we should experiment. My plan: 24h canary at 10% traffic to a quantized variant, run the Nimbus eval suite, and monitor hallucination/regression metrics. If safe, scale to 80%.
nate_sre: For latency stability, limit batch_window to 20ms on the low-latency route. Quantized kernels are faster but batching variance can spike p95. Also ensure KV prefix caching is enabled for the long-convo paths.
claire_prod: Nimbus has a renewal in ~8 weeks. We need a clear rollback plan and a short customer-facing note if we change model. Also capture expected cost savings vs. quality delta for the AMs.
rajesh_eng: Canary config I'm going to push (conceptual snippet):
```json
{
  "route": "nimbus-canary",
  "match": {"customer_id": "nimbus"},
  "policy": [
    {"model": "redwood-small-quant8", "weight": 10},
    {"model": "redwood-medium-fp16", "weight": 90}
  ],
  "metrics": {"eval_set": "nimbus_smoke", "duration_secs": 86400},
  "rollback": {"quality_drop_pct": 2, "p95_latency_increase_pct": 15}
}
```
maria_cs: Nice. Add cost monitoring (tokens-per-call, $/1000 tokens) and top-10 prompt regressors. We'll need a screenshot-ready dashboard for the AM check-in.
deploy-bot: Canary deploy scheduled for 1823370000 (1am UTC). Notifying @rajesh_eng, @nate_sre, @maria_cs.
rajesh_eng: I'll wire the eval hooks and alerting. If anything crosses thresholds, auto-rollback will run and post in this thread.
claire_prod: I'll draft the one-pager: expected 30-45% cost reduction on short responses, estimated 0.5-1.5% quality risk (based on prior quant regressions) and mitigation steps. Will share by EOD tomorrow.
maria_cs: Action items: ra:rajesh_eng (push canary + eval + rollback), ra:nate_sre (batch/window tweaks + observability), ra:claire_prod (customer-facing one-pager). Check-in: 24h after canary start. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
